title:
What is reported about Sinner: 

-Operated on Tuesday in Turku by renowned surgeon Lasse Lempainen.

-The procedure involved lengthening the iliotibial band through arthroscopy, using small Z-shaped incisions to reduce tension in the area.

-It was the less invasive surgical option, with an estimated success rate of 75–90%.

-Sinner is expected to be sidelined for approximately three months.

- His knee will initially be immobilised before he begins intensive physiotherapy to regain mobility and
